mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening household demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in periods where RSAFS YoY growth < -2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero during three consecutive months of UNRATE > 0.3pp increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in industrial production exceeding 1% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero during six consecutive months of INDPRO YoY growth < -1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5 percentage points signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero during periods of FEDFUNDS > 0.5pp increases in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 2% month-over-month decline in both real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based demand contraction, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline MoM > 2%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero during periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline MoM > 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 0.5 percentage point monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a 1% month-over-month decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a rapid labor market deterioration, which reduces corporate profit margins and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp AND PAYEMS declines MoM > 1%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero during periods when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp AND PAYEMS declines MoM > 1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1% combined with a 2% month-over-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based supply contraction, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY growth < -1% for 3 months AND HOUST declines MoM > 2%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero during periods when INDPRO YoY growth < -1% for 3 months AND HOUST declines MoM > 2% (t-test p > 0.05).
